title: A Study Of Skew-Polycyclic Codes Over A Non-Chain Ring
summary: For a prime \(p\) and a positive integer \(m\), let \(\mathbb{F}_{p^m}\) be the finite field of cardinality \(p^m\), and let $ R_{u^2,v^2,p^m} =\mathbb{F}_{p^m}+u\mathbb{F}_{p^m}+v\mathbb{F}_{p^m} +uv\mathbb{F}_{p^m}, ~ u^2=v^2=0,\ uv=vu, $ be a finite non-chain ring. In this paper, we study skew polycyclic codes of length \(lj\) associated with \(f(x)^j\), where \(f(x)\) is a central polynomial of degree \(l\) in $R_{u^2, v^2, p^m}[x; Θ],$ where $Θ$ being an automorphism of \(R_{u^2,v^2,p^m}\). We describe these codes, characterize free skew polycyclic codes, and determine their ranks.…
